records.jp: 詩さーん。なんかのんびりしないー？
records.en_original: Utaaa. Let's just kick back and relax, y'know?
records.en_auxiliary: Utaaa. Let's just kick back and relax, y'know?
records.en: Utaaa. Let's just kick back and relax, y'know?

records.jp: のんびりですか？<CR>私は十分、のんびりしているつもりですが……
records.en_original: Relax? I'm plenty relaxed...
records.en_auxiliary: Relax? I'm plenty relaxed...
records.en: Relax?<CR>I'm plenty relaxed...

records.jp: 星崎さんは、のんびりしていないんですか？
records.en_original: Are you feeling stressed, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you feeling stressed, Ao?
records.en: Are you not relaxing, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: んー。そういうわけじゃないんだけど……
records.en_original: Mmm, that's not exactly what I meant...
records.en_auxiliary: Mmm, that's not exactly what I meant...
records.en: Mmm, that's not exactly what I meant...

records.jp: ねー。屋上でできるのんびり。<CR>詩さんなら、どうしたい？
records.en_original: We need something we can do on the roof. Any ideas?
records.en_auxiliary: We need something we can do on the roof. Any ideas?
records.en: Right? Something relaxing we can do on the roof.<CR>What would Uta-san like to do?

records.jp: 屋上で……私が、ですか？
records.en_original: Something we can do on the roof...
records.en_auxiliary: Something we can do on the roof...
records.en: On the roof... what would I want to do?

records.jp: うん。詩さんが一番のんびりできそうなこと、<CR>私、知りたいなー
records.en_original: Yeah, what's the most relaxing thing that you can imagine.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, what's the most relaxing thing that you can imagine.
records.en: Yeah. I want to know what you think would be the most relaxing,<CR>Uta-san.

records.jp: 星崎さんとこうしているだけで、<CR>私はいつも、のんびりできてます
records.en_original: I feel like I'm relaxed whenever I'm with you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I'm relaxed whenever I'm with you, Ao.
records.en: I feel like I'm relaxed whenever I'm with you,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そ、そっか……
records.en_original: I-is that right...
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that right...
records.en: I-is that right...

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 屋上だからこそできるような感じで、<CR>もっとのんびりしたいなーって
records.en_original: I was just wondering if there was something we couldn't do anywhere else but here.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just wondering if there was something we couldn't do anywhere else but here.
records.en: I want to relax even more,<CR>in a way that is only possible because we are on the roof.

records.jp: 屋上だからこそ、ですか？<CR>この場所ならではのくつろぎ方……
records.en_original: A manner of relaxation only possible on a roof...
records.en_auxiliary: A manner of relaxation only possible on a roof...
records.en: A manner of relaxation<CR>only possible on a roof...

records.jp: そうそう。他の場所ではできないくつろぎ方で<CR>のんびりしたいなーって
records.en_original: Yeah, I wanna do something special!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I wanna do something special!
records.en: Right.<CR>I want to relax in a way we couldn't anywhere else.

records.jp: 他ではできない……すみません。<CR>私には思いつきません
records.en_original: Special... I'm sorry, I can't seem to think of anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Special... I'm sorry, I can't seem to think of anything.
records.en: Special...<CR>I'm sorry, I can't seem to think of anything.

records.jp: え、こんなの謝らなくていいから！
records.en_original: Oh, you don't have to apologize for that!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, you don't have to apologize for that!
records.en: Oh, you don't have to apologize for that!

records.jp: というわけで、いいこと思いついたんだけど、<CR>詩さん、ちょっといい？
records.en_original: I guess it's time for me to reveal my idea, then. Can you come here for a bit, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: I guess it's time for me to reveal my idea, then. Can you come here for a bit, Uta?
records.en: Actually, I just thought of something.<CR>Uta-san, do you have a minute?

records.jp: 詩さん、どうー？<CR>のんびりって感じしないー？
records.en_original: How does this feel? Do you feel relaxed?
records.en_auxiliary: How does this feel? Do you feel relaxed?
records.en: How is it, Uta-san?<CR>Doesn't it feel relaxing?

records.jp: どちらかというと、背中が熱いような……<CR>星崎さんは、熱くないですか？
records.en_original: I feel...like my back is quite warm. Do you feel hot, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: I feel...like my back is quite warm. Do you feel hot, Ao?
records.en: I feel...like my back is quite warm.<CR>Do you feel hot, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うーん
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 言われてみれば……背中からじりじりと<CR>炙られてる感がするかも？
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, it does feel a bit like my back is getting fried...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it, it does feel a bit like my back is getting fried...
records.en: Now that you mention it,<CR>it does feel a bit like my back is getting fried...

records.jp: 陽射しで床が熱を溜めていたんでしょうね
records.en_original: It must be because the ground has absorbed heat from the sunlight.
records.en_auxiliary: It must be because the ground has absorbed heat from the sunlight.
records.en: It must be because the ground has absorbed heat from the sunlight.

records.jp: な、なるほど。<CR>そこまで考えつかなかった
records.en_original: Oh, right. I didn't think of that.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, right. I didn't think of that.
records.en: Oh, right.<CR>I didn't think of that.

records.jp: でも……悪くはない気分です
records.en_original: It doesn't feel bad, however.
records.en_auxiliary: It doesn't feel bad, however.
records.en: It doesn't feel bad, however.

records.jp: た、たしかにちょっと熱いね。<CR>でも……だがそこがいい！
records.en_original: It is a little hot... But that's the best part!
records.en_auxiliary: It is a little hot... But that's the best part!
records.en: It is a little hot...<CR>But that's the best part!

records.jp: そこがいい……？<CR>星崎さんは、背中を温めたかったんですか？
records.en_original: It is...? Was the purpose of this to warm your back?
records.en_auxiliary: It is...? Was the purpose of this to warm your back?
records.en: That's what you like...?<CR>Did you want to warm your back, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: あ、そういうわけじゃなくて。<CR>夏の学校ならではだなーって思ってさ
records.en_original: Not exactly. It bring back memories of summer classes back in school.
records.en_auxiliary: Not exactly. It bring back memories of summer classes back in school.
records.en: That's not what I mean.<CR>I just thought it felt like summer at school.

records.jp: つまり……季節感を楽しんでいるんですね
records.en_original: So it's a seasonal activity?
records.en_auxiliary: So it's a seasonal activity?
records.en: So... you're enjoying the season itself.

records.jp: ……変かな？
records.en_original: ...Is that weird?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Is that weird?
records.en: ...Is that weird?

records.jp: 変かどうかはわかりませんが、<CR>奇妙な感覚がします
records.en_original: I'm not sure if I would call it weird, but I think it certainly is novel.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure if I would call it weird, but I think it certainly is novel.
records.en: I'm not sure if it's strange,<CR>but it feels... unusual.

records.jp: こうして寝そべってみると、発見がありますね
records.en_original: Laying here like this, I think I've discovered something.
records.en_auxiliary: Laying here like this, I think I've discovered something.
records.en: Laying here like this, I think I've discovered something.

records.jp: どんな発見したの？
records.en_original: What did you discover?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you discover?
records.en: What did you discover?

records.jp: 何だと思いますか？
records.en_original: What do you think it was?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think it was?
records.en: What do you think it was?

records.jp: そうだなぁ……<CR>これは私の発見だけど………
records.en_original: Hmm... Well, I had one myself, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well, I had one myself, but...
records.en: Hmm...<CR>Well, I had one myself, but...

records.jp: 聞かせてもらえますか？<CR>星崎さんの発見、聞きたいです
records.en_original: Could you tell me? I'd like to know what is.
records.en_auxiliary: Could you tell me? I'd like to know what is.
records.en: Could you tell me?<CR>I want to hear about your discovery, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 空が広いなぁ……って。<CR>普段、あんまり空って見上げないし
records.en_original: I was just thinking that the sky sure is big... I don't look up at it very much, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just thinking that the sky sure is big... I don't look up at it very much, I guess.
records.en: I was just thinking that the sky sure is big...<CR>I don't look up at it very much, I guess.

records.jp: はい。空ってこんなに広かったんですね。<CR>大きな発見です
records.en_original: It is quite vast. I think that's a very important discovery.
records.en_auxiliary: It is quite vast. I think that's a very important discovery.
records.en: Yeah. I never realized the sky was this vast.<CR>That's a pretty big discovery.

records.jp: 他に遮るもの無いから、よけい迫力。<CR>ちょっと怖くなるくらい
records.en_original: When there's nothing blocking it, it really feels massive. It's almost a little scary.
records.en_auxiliary: When there's nothing blocking it, it really feels massive. It's almost a little scary.
records.en: When there's nothing blocking it, it really feels massive.<CR>It's almost a little scary.

records.jp: 人間って、とても小さな存在なんだなぁって、<CR>そう感じます
records.en_original: It makes you feel just how small humans are.
records.en_auxiliary: It makes you feel just how small humans are.
records.en: It makes you feel just how small<CR>humans are.

records.jp: 私たちの存在も悩みも、この世界と比べたら<CR>どうしようもなく小さなものなんだな……と
records.en_original: Our existence, our worries; they are nothing in the great scheme of things. We are very small.
records.en_auxiliary: Our existence, our worries; they are nothing in the great scheme of things. We are very small.
records.en: Compared with this world,<CR>both our existence and our worries are hopelessly small...

records.jp: 詩さん……<CR>もしかして、不安になっちゃった？
records.en_original: Uta... Does that make you feel uncomfortable?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta... Does that make you feel uncomfortable?
records.en: Uta-san...<CR>Did that make you anxious?

records.jp: 不安、ですか？　それはありません。<CR>むしろ……ほっとしました
records.en_original: Uncomfortable? No, actually. It makes me feel...relieved,
records.en_auxiliary: Uncomfortable? No, actually. It makes me feel...relieved,
records.en: Anxious? No. Actually...<CR>I felt relieved.

records.jp: 私は、ただの私でしかない……<CR>いえ、私たちは、私たちでしかないんだなぁって
records.en_original: I am me and nothing else. No... We are us and nothing else.
records.en_auxiliary: I am me and nothing else. No... We are us and nothing else.
records.en: I am me and nothing else.<CR>No... We are us and nothing else.

records.jp: だから、悩んだり怯えたりするより……<CR>ただ、自分にできることを頑張ればいいんですね
records.en_original: So instead of feeling some kind of existential dread, I can focus on doing the best I can with who I am.
records.en_auxiliary: So instead of feeling some kind of existential dread, I can focus on doing the best I can with who I am.
records.en: So instead of worrying or being afraid...<CR>I should just do my best with what I can do.

records.jp: 詩さん……
records.en_original: Uta...
records.en_auxiliary: Uta...
records.en: Uta-san...

records.jp: （本当の詩さんって、<CR>すごく強い人なんだなぁ……）
records.en_original: (Uta sure is strong...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Uta sure is strong...)
records.en: (Uta-san<CR>sure is strong...)

records.jp: 星崎さん。<CR>これ、とてものんびりできますね……
records.en_original: This really is quite relaxing, isn't it, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: This really is quite relaxing, isn't it, Ao?
records.en: This really is quite relaxing,<CR>isn't it, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うん。私もすごくのんびり
records.en_original: Yeah. I feel the same way.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I feel the same way.
records.en: Yeah. I feel the same way.

records.jp: なんか、肩こりがすごくほぐれる気がする！<CR>熱いは熱いんだけど、快眠できそう
records.en_original: That knot I always have in my shoulder is totally gone! It may be a little hot, but I feel like I could have a nice nap here.
records.en_auxiliary: That knot I always have in my shoulder is totally gone! It may be a little hot, but I feel like I could have a nice nap here.
records.en: That knot I always have in my shoulder is totally gone!<CR>It may be a little hot, but I feel like I could have a nice nap here.

records.jp: 温熱効果ですね。<CR>たしかに体がほぐれるような気がします
records.en_original: It must be the warmth. I can also feel it loosening up my body.
records.en_auxiliary: It must be the warmth. I can also feel it loosening up my body.
records.en: It must be the warmth.<CR>I can also feel it loosening up my body.

records.jp: でしょでしょ！<CR>でも、それだけじゃなくてさ……
records.en_original: Yeah, exactly! But that's not all...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, exactly! But that's not all...
records.en: Yeah, exactly!<CR>But that's not all...

records.jp: うーん。手足を思いっきり伸ばすと、<CR>更に気持ちいい！
records.en_original: Oooh... it feels even better when I stretch out like this!
records.en_auxiliary: Oooh... it feels even better when I stretch out like this!
records.en: Oooh...<CR>it feels even better when I stretch out like this!

records.jp: ん……あ、本当ですね！<CR>なんだか、開放感を感じます
records.en_original: Nnngh... Ah, you're right! I feel like I'm free.
records.en_auxiliary: Nnngh... Ah, you're right! I feel like I'm free.
records.en: Nnngh... Ah, you're right!<CR>I feel like I'm free.

records.jp: えへへ、よかった。<CR>詩さんに喜んでもらえて
records.en_original: Hehehe, I'm glad you're enjoying yourself!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe, I'm glad you're enjoying yourself!
records.en: Hehe,<CR>I'm glad you enjoyed it, Uta-san.

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、変な人ですね。<CR>私が喜ぶことを喜んでくれるなんて
records.en_original: You're a strange one, Ao. Why should my enjoyment have any effect on yours.
records.en_auxiliary: You're a strange one, Ao. Why should my enjoyment have any effect on yours.
records.en: You're a strange person, Hoshizaki-san.<CR>You get happy just because I'm happy.
